manifest.title: AGRIBALYSE 3.2 — French Agricultural and Food Product LCA Spreadsheets and Methodological Documentation
manifest.provider: ADEME, INRAE (Means-InOut), GIS REVALIM, EVEA S.A. Coopérative
manifest.version: v3.2 (September 2024 release; food products workbook published Aug 2025; conventional agriculture workbook updated 18/11/2025; organic updated 12/11/2024)
manifest.geography: FR (France consumption mix for food products; France farm gate for agriculture)
manifest.functional_unit: 1 kg of food product consumed at the consumer (food workbook); 1 kg of agricultural product at farm gate (agriculture workbooks)
manifest.system_boundary: Cradle-to-grave / field-to-plate across 6 stages (Agriculture, Transformation, Emballage, Transport, Supermarché et distribution, Consommation) for food products; cradle-to-farm-gate for agricultural products
manifest.lcia_method: EF 3.1 adapted for SimaPro v1.00 (EF 3.1 normalization/weighting single score mPt + 16 midpoint indicators + 3 climate sub-indicators; long-term emissions included)
manifest.intended_use: Finished dairy product LCA reference benchmarks, stage contribution analysis (including embedded Emballage stage), raw milk farm-gate comparison, and cheese yield/density reference
manifest.limitations: Product-level food impacts already embed a fixed baseline packaging ('PACK AGB' or 'PACK PROXY') and consumer losses; cannot be used as a free-form packaging BOM engine without subtracting or holding constant the embedded Emballage stage; 7 duplicate Code AGB rows exist for packaging fixes; Egg and Quinoa FR errors flagged in Notice

selection_rationale.verified_intended_use: Finished dairy product LCA reference benchmarks, stage contribution analysis (including embedded Emballage stage), raw milk farm-gate comparison, and cheese yield/density reference

manifest.title: French PDO Cheeses LCI, LCIA and Process Characterization Dataset (44 PDO Cheeses)
manifest.provider: French PDO Cheese LCA Research Authors (INRAE / Institut Agro / Actalia Dataverse deposit)
manifest.version: 2022 deposit (workbooks modified 2022-04-04 to 2022-08-25; PDO specs accessed Sep/Nov 2020)
manifest.url: not_embedded_in_raw_files (Dataverse bundle with MANIFEST.TXT; INAO spec URLs in specifications workbook)
manifest.licence: not_embedded_in_raw_files (verify Dataverse landing page licence before external redistribution)
manifest.geography: FR (44 French Protected Designation of Origin cheese supply chains; Ecoinvent 3 FR/RER/GLO & AGRIBALYSE 3.0 FR)
manifest.reference_year: 2020-2022 (PDO specifications accessed 2020; workbooks modified 2022; AGRIBALYSE 3.0 milk)
manifest.functional_unit: 1 kg of ripened cheese (FU = 1kg of cheese)
manifest.system_boundary: Cradle-to-ripened-cheese factory/shared-cellar exit gate across 7 base stages (Milk production, Milk transport, Milk pumping, Milk storage, Milk processing, Cheese ripening, Equipment cleaning) plus Cheese transport in Alternative scenario; excludes packaging, retail and consumer stages
manifest.lcia_method: EF 3.0 / ILCD-compatible 28-indicator midpoint suite (16 main categories + 3 climate sub-indicators + 9 toxicity/ecotoxicity chemical-group sub-indicators; no single score)
manifest.intended_use: Cheese manufacturing process LCI/LCIA reference, co-product allocation study, and exploratory 44-cheese case study grouped strictly by cheese entity
manifest.limitations: Small specialized sample (44 cheeses); LCIA sheet has 1,232 cheese x indicator rows (28 per cheese) which are NOT independent observations; excludes packaging; data_PDOcheeses_LCI lacks .xlsx extension and labels ripening wood as m3 in Initial scenario vs kg in Additional scenario; trailing whitespace and 'Camenbert'/'Camembert' spelling mismatch across tables; no DOI/licence embedded in files

selection_rationale.verified_intended_use: Cheese manufacturing process LCI/LCIA reference, co-product allocation study, and exploratory 44-cheese case study grouped strictly by cheese entity

manifest.title: U.S. Life Cycle Inventory (USLCI) Database (openLCA JSON-LD Export)
manifest.provider: National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) / Federal LCA Commons
manifest.licence: USLCI Public Use / Federal LCA Commons Open Terms (free public use with citation)
manifest.geography: US / Northern America primary (730 US, 182 Northern America, 96 Global, 391 unspecified/regional variants)
manifest.functional_unit: Process-specific quantitative reference flow (primarily 1 kg, 1000 kg, 1.10516007 kg, 13.5 kg, 1 Mg, 1 sh tn = 907.18474 kg, 1 t*km, 1 m3, 1 l, 1 MJ, or 1 kWh)
manifest.system_boundary: Gate-to-gate unit processes (1,408 UNIT_PROCESS) and cradle-to-gate aggregated processes (26 LCI_RESULT)
manifest.lcia_method: None bundled in export (0 lcia_methods in JSON-LD; requires external TRACI/IPCC/EF characterization factors)
manifest.intended_use: Packaging material, conversion, recycled resin, fuel combustion, freight transport and end-of-life inventory reference for BOM-based packaging and logistics modelling
manifest.limitations: No bundled LCIA characterization methods; 97 Bridge Processes (including all 27 US Electricity Baseline bridges and 55 USEEIO bridges such as Flat glass Bridge) have 0 elementary flows and unlinked upstream inputs (2,171 of 6,833 product-flow inputs lack an internal provider in this standalone export); no container glass or liquid packaging board (LPB) process; non-uniform reference units (sh tn, Mg, 1000 kg); no cost or price data

selection_rationale.verified_intended_use: Packaging material, conversion, recycled resin, fuel combustion, freight transport and end-of-life inventory reference for BOM-based packaging and logistics modelling

manifest.title: Life-Cycle Analysis Datasets for Regionalized Plastic Pathways (ANL/ESIA-24/3)
manifest.provider: Argonne National Laboratory (ANL) and National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
manifest.licence: U.S. Government / DOE OSTI Public Technical Report
manifest.geography: USA, Western Europe, MENA (Middle East and North Africa), China, and 4-region Cross-regional average
manifest.reference_year: 2024 report (GREET 2022 model; 2020 IEA electricity/NG data; 2010-2016 baseline technology shares with 2019-2022 sensitivity)
manifest.functional_unit: 1 kg of virgin plastic resin (PET, HDPE, LDPE, PP, PVC) or 1 kg of olefin monomer (ethylene, propylene); also 1 kWh electricity and 1 MJ natural gas in Figure 18
manifest.system_boundary: Cradle-to-gate virgin resin / monomer production (raw material extraction through monomer and polymerization at plant gate; excludes package conversion, transport to dairy, filling and end-of-life)
manifest.lcia_method: GREET 2022 100-year GHG Carbon Intensity (kg CO2e / kg, covering CO2, CH4, N2O)
manifest.file_path: data/raw/[2024  Taemin Kim] Life-Cycle Analysis Datasets for Regionalized Plastic Pathways.pdf.pdf
manifest.data_type: published-reference (PDF report tables and figure values)
manifest.intended_use: Regionalized cradle-to-gate carbon intensity factors for virgin PET, HDPE, LDPE, PP and PVC resins and sensitivity to monomer/feedstock pathways and regional electricity grids
manifest.limitations: Cradle-to-gate virgin resin only (not a complete package LCA; excludes blow molding/thermoforming and EoL); MENA is a macro-regional proxy, not Uzbekistan; covers GHG carbon intensity only (no water/eutrophication); prose on p. 28 misstates USA PTA-based PET CI as 1.92 (China's value) whereas Table 5 shows 1.75; filename has double .pdf.pdf suffix

selection_rationale.verified_intended_use: Regionalized cradle-to-gate carbon intensity factors for virgin PET, HDPE, LDPE, PP and PVC resins and sensitivity to monomer/feedstock pathways and regional electricity grids

manifest.title: Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) Guidelines for Dairy Processing
manifest.provider: International Finance Corporation (IFC) / World Bank Group (citing Nordic Council of Ministers 2001 & EDA 2002 / EC 2006)
manifest.licence: World Bank Group / IFC Public EHS Guideline Terms
manifest.geography: International guideline; Table 2-3 benchmarks from European, Swedish, Danish, Finnish and Norwegian dairies
manifest.reference_year: 2007 publication (underlying plant survey benchmarks from 2001-2002 / EC 2006 BREF)
manifest.functional_unit: Per unit of processed milk or product: L/L processed milk, kWh/L processed milk, Liters/L processed milk, kg/1000 l (solid waste), L/kg ice cream, KWh/kg ice cream; mg/l, pH, degC, MPN/100 ml for effluent guidelines
manifest.system_boundary: Gate-to-gate dairy processing facility operations (milk reception, processing, CIP cleaning, utilities, wastewater discharge and solid waste; excludes raw milk farming and upstream packaging manufacture)
manifest.lcia_method: Operational intensity benchmarks and regulatory/guideline effluent concentration limits (not LCIA)
manifest.data_type: published-reference (historical industry benchmark ranges and EHS effluent guidelines)
manifest.intended_use: Sanity-check bounds and default proxy ranges for dairy plant water intake, energy consumption, wastewater discharge, solid waste generation and effluent pollutant limits; template for company data collection
manifest.limitations: Published in 2007 from 2001-2002 European/Nordic dairy surveys (not current Uzbekistan plant data or regulation); values are wide plant-level ranges, not independent ML training observations; Ice cream energy cell (0.75-1.6 KWh/kg) spans all four Nordic country columns as a single merged cell

selection_rationale.verified_intended_use: Sanity-check bounds and default proxy ranges for dairy plant water intake, energy consumption, wastewater discharge, solid waste generation and effluent pollutant limits; template for company data collection

selection_note: Alternatives considered / rejected: Not recorded / Unknown. The project artifacts record the selected sources and gaps (e.g. USLCI lacks container glass and liquid packaging board, filled by labelled proxies) but no explicit candidate-dataset comparison.
